title: API key request-rate spike across multiple source ASNs within one hour
event_type: AI API gateway authentication log, hourly aggregation, sourcetype api_auth (supports DET-21-06)

callouts.explanation: Six distinct source ASNs for one key inside a single hour clears the tuned distinct_asns >= 4 bar DET-21-06 uses instead of a naive distinct_asns > 1 threshold, which would false-positive on ordinary roaming interactive use.
842 requests against a 7-day trailing average of 38 per hour is the request-rate-spike leg of the detection, evaluated alongside — not instead of — the ASN-diversity signal.

Tags this key as interactive rather than a service/backend key; DET-21-06's False Positive Trap calls for separate thresholds per key_type since service keys behind autoscaling infrastructure legitimately span many ASNs.
Surfaced for analyst sanity-checking against the key's known model-tier list, per the prose above the query — not yet thresholded on as a standalone trigger in DET-21-06 itself.

note: This is a conceptual, illustrative field breakdown of an API usage aggregation row to support DET-21-06 — not a captured screenshot of any real vendor dashboard.
